div.head: I Ew 2
div.ab: Eac we cwædon, hwæs se wyrðe wære þe oðrum ryhtes wyrnde aðor oððe on boclande oððe on folclande; ⁊ ðæt he him geandágode of þam folclande, hwonne he him riht worhte beforan ðam gerefan.
Eac we cwædon, hwæs se wyrðe wære ðe oðrum rihtes wyrnde aðor oððe on boclande oððe on folclande, hwonne he him riht worhte beforan ðam gerefan.
Item diximus, cuius dignus esset, qui rectum alicui disfortiet uel in bocland uel in folcland; et ut ei adterminetur in folclánd, quando rectum uelit ei facere coram preposito suo.

[Be ðone ðe oþrum rihtes wyrnþ.] Eac we cwædon, hwæs se wyrðe wære þe oðrum ryhtes wyrnde aðor oððe on boclande oððe on folclande; ⁊ ðæt he him geandágode of þam folclande, hwonne he him riht worhte beforan ðam gerefan.

(Von dem, der einem anderen Recht[sgang] weigert. Ld) Auch bestimmten wir, wessen der [Verklagte] schuldig sei, welcher einem anderen Recht[sgang] verweigert, sei es an Urkunden-Grundeigenthum oder an volks[rechtlichem] Grundeigen; und dass für das volks[rechtliche] Grundeigen [Kläg]er ihm einen Termin setze, wann [Verklagt]er ihm vor dem Gerichtsvogte Recht erfülle.

(Of one who refuses another [due process of] law. Ld) We also determined what the [accused] is liable for who refuses another [due process of] law, whether concerning land held by charter or land held by folk-right; and that for folk-land [the plaintiff] should fix him a term on which [the accused] should do him right before the reeve.

Further, we have declared what [penalty] he is liable to, who withholds from another his rights either in ‘bookland’ or ‘folkland.' And with regard to the ‘folkland' [we have declared] that he [the plaintiff] shall appoint a day when he [the defendant] shall do him justice in the presence of the reeve.

Die Vorladung (s. d. Gl 2a. 6a) geschieht aussergerichtlich, zum Gerichtstage vor dem Vogt. Also ist das vom Beklagten geweigerte riht Prozesseinlassung und Erfüllung des Endurteils; vgl. Gl Rechtsweigerung 3a; Gerichtsversäumnis 2; Rückfall 6b ff.

The summons (see that word in Gl 2a. 6a) takes place out of court, for the court day before the reeve. Hence the riht refused by the defendant is his engaging in the suit and his fulfilment of the final judgement; cf. Gl Rechtsweigerung 3a; Gerichtsversäumnis 2; Rückfall 6b ff.
Die Stelle duldet auch die Übs.: ‘für Folcland [Beklagt]er ihm [dem Kläger] Termin setze, wann er’
The passage also admits the translation: ‘für Folcland [Beklagt]er ihm [dem Kläger] Termin setze, wann er’
For ‘bookland,’ ‘folkland’ see references quoted in the note on Alf. cap. 41.
This passage might also be translated ‘that he (the defendant) shall appoint a day when he shall do him (the plaintiff) justice,’ etc.
